nodes.title: Read the greet tutorial
nodes.summary: Section 1: the tutorial was written for greet v1, which took --name. No files change. Done when you can name the flag the tutorial uses.

verification.prompt: Say which flag the tutorial uses to pass the name.

nodes.title: Install the greet script (v2)
nodes.summary: Section 2: write an executable greet script. This is v2, which takes --who and rejects --name.
commands:
cat > greet <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import argparse

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog='greet')
parser.add_argument('--who', default='world')
args = parser.parse_args()
print('Hello, ' + args.who)
EOF
chmod +x greet

nodes.title: Note your Python version
nodes.summary: Section 2b: a manual side note outside the workspace. Sibling of 2-write-greet.

verification.prompt: Confirm you noted your python3 version.

nodes.title: Run greet with --name Ada
nodes.summary: Section 3: the v1 prose runs ./greet --name Ada. Against v2 this fails, so the node is the stale point. Done when the output contains Hello, Ada.

nodes.title: Finish the tutorial
nodes.summary: Section 4: a closing manual check. Only reachable after 3-run-greet.

verification.prompt: Confirm the greeting printed as expected.
